items.title: Renew Alexandria business license (BPOL)
items.description: Business licenses must be renewed annually by March 1 of each license year; existing businesses file the renewal and pay the tax by that date.

feeDetail.note: The license tax is based on the business's gross receipts and classification, so no single amount applies.

penalty.note: The city's Business Tax page: the greater of $10 or 10% of the tax for late payment, plus interest.

note: A March 1 BPOL renewal is described by third-party sources only; the city's own page was not confirmed.

items.title: Review applicable local licenses and permits in Chesapeake
items.description: Review the cited local licensing source before operating; requirements may be activity-specific and can differ by business type or location.

feeDetail.note: The fee depends on the type of business and license; the city or county sets it in its fee schedule.

penalty.note: This entry covers the city's local licenses and taxes generally, each of which carries its own late charge in the municipal code; no single amount is stated.

items.title: Renew Hampton business license (BPOL)
items.authority: City of Hampton Commissioner of the Revenue
items.description: Licenses expire December 31 each year and must be renewed by March 1 of the following year.

feeDetail.note: The license tax is based on the business's gross receipts and classification, so no single amount applies.

penalty.note: Virginia rules let a locality impose a 10% penalty for late filing or payment of the license tax; the city's own pages were not read for a different rate.

items.title: Renew Newport News business license (BPOL)
items.authority: City of Newport News Commissioner of the Revenue
items.description: Licenses expire at the end of each calendar year and must be renewed by March 1; auto dealers pay quarterly.

feeDetail.note: The license tax is based on the business's gross receipts and classification, so no single amount applies.

penalty.note: Virginia rules let a locality impose a 10% penalty for late filing or payment of the license tax; the city's own pages were not read for a different rate.

items.title: Renew Norfolk business license (BPOL)
items.authority: City of Norfolk Commissioner of the Revenue
items.description: Business licenses run January 1 to December 31 and are based on the prior year's gross receipts. Renewal is due March 1; late payment carries a penalty and interest.

feeDetail.note: The license tax is based on the business's gross receipts and classification, so no single amount applies.

penalty.note: The city's renewal page: the greater of $10 or 10% of the tax if not renewed by the March 1 due date, plus interest.

items.title: Renew Richmond business license (BPOL)
items.authority: City of Richmond Department of Finance
items.description: Business licenses expire December 31. Renewal application and payment are due March 1 (the next workday if it falls on a weekend); the late penalty is 10% or $10, whichever is greater, plus interest.

feeDetail.note: Based on the business's gross receipts.

penalty.note: 10% or $10, whichever is greater, plus interest.

items.title: Renew Roanoke business license (BPOL)
items.authority: City of Roanoke Commissioner of the Revenue and Treasurer
items.description: Renewal applications and payment are due March 1 (the next business day if it falls on a weekend), online at the city's tax portal, by mail or in person.

feeDetail.note: The license tax is based on the business's gross receipts and classification, so no single amount applies.

penalty.note: Virginia rules let a locality impose a 10% penalty for late filing or payment of the license tax; the city's own pages were not read for a different rate.

items.title: Renew Virginia Beach business license (BPOL)
items.authority: City of Virginia Beach Commissioner of the Revenue
items.description: Business licenses are based on the prior calendar year's gross receipts; renewal payment is due on or before March 1, after which penalty and interest may apply.

feeDetail.note: The license tax is based on the business's gross receipts and classification, so no single amount applies.

penalty.note: The Commissioner of the Revenue says penalty and interest may be applied after the March 1 due date without stating a rate; Virginia rules allow a 10% penalty.
